result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 81 passed C's browser checks and is published, and round 82 is ready for A. Its baseline is the gate-81 commit `efbed86`. The store is unchanged (0 changes) and all 467 frozen files are intact.

**Round 81 result:**
- C passed all 20 rows at both viewports, with `browserVerified` and `realVerified` true. Group volume, mute and nesting were confirmed by measuring the exported audio. The fake-Bearer 403 check is blocked only because the backend isn't running in the cloud.
- The backlog is now version 81, updated only from C's evidence. SRW-17 (track groups) is complete in code. It shows as **მოწმდება** rather than **მზადაა**, because the Tech Lead's manual checks R79-T, R80-T and R81-T are still open.
- C found two Low bugs:
  - **C81-1:** nested group names get cut to `ჯგუ…`. It goes to the Lows batch and Tech Lead check R81-T. I did not set a maximum nesting depth, because that would cut back FB-12 without your approval.
  - **C81-2:** doc 070 line 72 is out of date. It is fixed in round 82.

**C-R80-O3 ruling (D-29z47):** the clip landing at 1.025 s is the agreed FB-03 rule: on an occupied lane the clip stays at its last valid place. No frozen test says otherwise. The real defect is that the status after release never says where the clip ended up. Round 82 fixes only that status message (fix X1); the clip's position does not change. It stays Low, and since C already reproduced it, no separate repro round is needed.

**Round 82 task: SRW-18 stage 1, clip fade in / fade out (R18-A1)**
- **Model:** audio clips get optional fade-in and fade-out lengths, and the two together can never exceed the clip length. The logic lives in a new `fades.ts`.
- **Edits:**
  - moving and copying a clip keeps its fades;
  - trimming shortens the fade at the trimmed edge first;
  - split, Delete Time, Cut and range Delete remove the fade at any newly cut edge.
- **Audio:** live playback and export share the same code. A faded clip gets its own gain node with a straight-line ramp, and playback that starts mid-fade begins at the right level. Clips without fades build exactly the same audio graph as before.
- **Two frozen-test constraints:**
  - the new export line must avoid the substring `pan` (an existing test forbids it there);
  - the two new audio ramp methods are optional, because three frozen test fakes implement that interface.
- **Interaction:** small 10×10 px handles on the clip. Each drag is one undo entry, double-click resets a fade to 0, and an interrupted (cancelled) drag reverts.
- **Docs:** fixes to doc 070 line 72 and doc 071 line 4, plus a new doc 072.
- **C's checks:** 16 rows at both viewports. The main proof is in the export: the faded audio divided by the unfaded audio must follow the fade line sample by sample, within 0.01.
- **Differences from Ableton (Live 12 manual §6.8), all recorded:** fades are linear only, double-click instead of Delete removes a fade, there are no crossfades, and no automatic 4 ms edge fades are added. That last one closes C-R28-INFO-NO-EDGE-FADES as a recorded difference.

Stage 2 (the clip volume envelope, R18-A2) follows; nothing in SRW-18 was cut back. Round 83 will be a regression round if it is planned on or after 2026-10-24.

**Advisor:** available and used twice, before writing and on the finished artifacts. I applied its four suggested sharpenings to the task. I consulted no project subagents.

**Architecture checkpoint:** the reviewers' note (move the mixer-volume state logic out of `ArrangementContext`) is logged as a backlog signal, not a task. I added it as question 10 to the checkpoint request for root. Both the SRW-16 and SRW-17 feature boundaries have now passed without a root answer. This does not block anything.

`regression-last.json` is unchanged. I made no commits or pushes and changed no app code.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- tasks/round-81.md
- b-round-81.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json
- feature-status.md
- b-round-78-checkpoint-request.md

The new decision D-29z47 is in `docs/technical/studio-real-workspace/plan.md`.
